quest.title: Away With Obsessions and Falsehood
quest.description: The time for the critical battle has arrived. You return to the Mystic Onmyou Chamber and meet up with Childe and Shiki Taishou. Time to get to the bottom of all these mysteries...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Traveler, I found out some good news from the garrisoned forces!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Kujou Sara has been tied down with work in the city. Nothin' seems to be goin' on with her troops for now.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Besides that, we haven't had any new monsters escape the Domain for quite some time, and the troops have complete control of the pass. I don't think they're in a hurry to attack the Domain right now.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Seems we got more time than we bargained for!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then let's get going! Those two must be getting impatient!

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Oh! You're back!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Okay, now that we're all here, whaddya say we get to the bottom of this?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: You two look like you've been through a war!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Just one war? Haha, I've lost count of how many battles we've had down here.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: I did okay, right, Shiki Taishou?

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Mr. Tartaglia is no stranger to Domains. He was able to deal with even the most powerful monsters with ease.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: I am confident that we can make it to the innermost depths of the Domain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, you two seem to have gotten much closer over the last few days.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Well, we've fought shoulder to shoulder for quite a while now.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Alright, listen up. During the rearrangement, Shiki Taishou said he could sense the most important replica over there.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Compared with the other replicas, it should contain a far greater power within. If I can fuse with it successfully, I should be able to remember the truth of this Domain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's right there? Then how come you guys haven't gone over yet?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Shiki Taishou... were you waitin' for us this whole time?

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Without your companionship, I never would have made it this far.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: My memories were only retrieved thanks to everyone's efforts. I feel it's only right that you're here with me to witness this final and most important juncture.

talks.objective: Retrieve a replica of Shiki Taishou

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: My memories, fragmented for so long... are finally complete.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: I remember it all now... The origin of the Mystic Onmyou Chamber... Its essence.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: This realm is not for practicing onmyoudou, nor is it for harnessing evil. The reason Harunosuke created me and the Domain... Our sole purpose... was to protect.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Protect?

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Our nation was once attacked by a great evil, and a person of importance to Harunosuke was taken from him...

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: He was filled with hatred and regret, and began yearning for the strength to take on the evil himself.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: He made his way across the ocean to seek the adepti of Liyue, and went on to study the adepti arts. He combined those subtle techniques with the art of transcension that he himself had practiced over the years, and founded the earliest version of onmyoudou.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Later, he rallied all samurai with the will to serve in protecting the nation, and created me and this onmyou chamber... With me as a template, he would create many replicas, assigning each to a samurai.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: The samurai and shikigami were partners, combining their martial prowess and charm magic to take on monsters with great efficiency.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: They worked in pairs, and set out to rid the land of monsters. Information on the defeated monsters would be recorded within the shikigami.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Upon returning to the Domain, that information would be channeled into the creation of mirror monsters — training targets for the samurai.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: As the first shikigami, I was constantly absorbing the knowledge and experiences of the replicas. I was able to improve the structure of the Domain, and provide better training for the samurai.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Over time, these dedicated samurai were able to achieve an enviable martial prowess. A new batch of recruits would arrive as the last group left the Domain. The cycle of new knowledge and new opponents seemed to be never ending...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A Domain for training?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: No wonder the fighting never stops here... This was a training ground to begin with.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In another words, Kamuna Harunosuke built this onmyou chamber to train samurai to fight monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Doesn't that make him a pretty great guy?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: If that's the case, why is he hiding away in the depths of the Domain?

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: No... Harunosuke is no longer here.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: For reasons unknown, Harunosuke disbanded the samurai and abandoned the Domain.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: This part of my memory is still fragmented... I can't remember what Harunosuke said to me before he left.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Left? Meanin'... he's still alive?

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: It's possible... and I hope he is.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: I am a weapon created by Harunosuke. The purpose of the onmyou chamber, my purpose, is to facilitate combat, to train myself and others.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: But this Domain was abandoned. The only people to have come here since are yourselves. What use does a weapon discarded by its owner have to offer...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is really tough for Shiki Taishou...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: A discarded weapon... Hah.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Discarded or not, what's so bad about being a weapon? All those who stalk the battlefield yearn for meaning and value.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Do you think so...?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: You were interested in my secret, right? Why is it that I'm able to withstand the resistance of the Domain? Why is it that I'm able to face down complex battles with ease?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: I have fought in the fissures that lie between great tree roots. Boundless danger, fatal encounters... These are the ingredients I use to become stronger still.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: It is not victory that I seek, but improvement. I want to become sharp as a blade, to the point where others fear me. You're not the only weapon here, Shiki Taishou.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: If that's true... then these battles you strive for... Where do they end?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Only those that wish for an end will find one. For me, it's nothing more than a mirage.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: I was born to fight, and as long as I draw breath, there will be no end to my purpose. My limits vanish behind the horizon with every step that I take.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Let go of your confusion. Sorrow and hesitation are the enemy of an implacable weapon.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: What must I do... to let go...?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Don't worry, you don't have to abandon somethin' to succeed in lettin' go.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: You don't have to abandon' anythin', Shiki Taishou.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: You've only just regained your memories — this is the perfect opportunity to pick up where you left off. All you gotta do is find the thing that was most important and righteous to you.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Most important... and righteous?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Yup! For me, it's rock 'n' roll.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: It's not everyone's cup of tea. In fact, I'd say it's kinda unpopular, really. But if it makes me happy, that's all that matters!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: What do I care if someone doesn't share my passion? All I need to worry about is doin' what I enjoy!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: So if people wanna roll their eyes or give me the cold shoulder, they can have at it! My music was never meant for those that couldn't understand it.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: ...I still remember your test... The song you played for me.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: You said that you were walkin' alone, that you spent time in the company of others eatin' Grilled Fish by a fire.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Your answer was filled with an understandin' of human emotion.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: We've all journeyed down a path of solitude at some point in our lives. Your presence there puts you in good company. You found us and joined us by the fire, and we became friends.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: The road ahead is difficult, but we're never alone. Shiki Taishou, this is the language in my music, and my reward for stickin' to the path right for me. What about you?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I know there'll be something callin' out to you.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Miss Xinyan... I may not be able to harness the optimism you carry with you just yet. But I do know that my journey doesn't end here.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Everyone, we continue on! I want to— No... I must retrieve the last replica, and regain control of this Domain!

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Yes... There has to be something left that only I am capable of doing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's more like it! Get ready everyone, there's more fighting ahead!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As long as we move forward together, there's nothing to worry about!

talks.objective: Go deeper into The Vengeful Wood

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Harunosuke didn't abandon me... I enlightened him. I helped him to release a burden shouldered for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Harunosuke had great aspirations for me and the Mystic Onmyou Chamber. But the truth is... Perhaps we were an ill-timed creation.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: The samurai trained tirelessly, and with promising results. And yet, the strength of mortals is bound by unforgiving limits. Our progress was... too slow.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Even as we trained, the god with the power of the Musou no Hitotachi swept across the land with a force of diligent and mighty warriors. They removed all hidden evils from our territory.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: And just like that, a life's work was rendered unnecessary... No one in this world is prepared when such sorrow befalls them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The power of the gods can be cruel.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't begin to imagine how that feels, but we've definitely heard about similar cases...

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: I was lost, dejected, and doubted everything in sight.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Still... the fruits of our labor and valiant efforts cannot be denied, even if they were overshadowed.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Regardless, the aim that Harunosuke and the samurai sought had been achieved. The samurai no longer needed to devote their life to training...

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: It should have been something to celebrate... but Harunosuke was a sentimental man. His affections were rooted in mortal desire, and he couldn't bear to let go of what he had lost.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: To protect was our shared ambition. And if the world was the object of Harunosuke's protection... then he was the object of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: As his most prized creation and only friend in the Mystic Onmyou Chamber, I tried to persuade him.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: He told me that he wanted to set out again in search of a new purpose... that it may take him months, years, or even centuries. It didn't matter to me. All I wanted was for him to achieve that aspiration, and to return to this place anew.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: And in the endless days of waiting... I fell into a deep slumber...

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Harunosuke... You're not coming back, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Don't be upset, Shiki Taishou...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If Kamuna Harunosuke learned the power of the adepti arts and transcension, isn't it possible that he became immortal?

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: ...What I've come to realize is that regardless of whether he remains in this world... he shouldn't be the sole purpose of my existence.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Meeting all of you helped me understand belief. I believe that Harunosuke is walking his own path now... and I believe that I too can find a path of my own.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: From birth, we begin to walk in solitude toward an inevitable end. But there are embers in the mist that welcome us, and friendships to be made under the night sky...

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Our assignment does not end because the journey is long.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: There was value in everything Harunosuke did... and my purpose is my assignment. That's something that will never change, nor will it be taken away from me.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: I am Shiki Taishou, the first shikigami, ally of martial artists, and forevermore the overseer of the Mystic Onmyou Chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: My duty is to assist fighters in reaching ultimate attainment.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: There will be others in this world attempting to scale the highest peak. I will gladly become a bridge between the mountains — a weapon that carries them through the clouds.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Now that's what I'm talkin' about, haha!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, full-memory Shiki Taishou is a force to be reckoned with!

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I've regained full control of the Mystic Onmyou Chamber. No mirror monsters will be able to escape this Domain from now on. The crisis has been averted.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: In a few days' time, I'll be able to secure the charm magic network and restore the Mystic Onmyou Chamber to its original state.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: This place is an ever-changing yet reliable training ground. I will continue to stand guard here, and provide training for anyone seeking ultimate attainment.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: The Tenryou Commission must already have made preparations to enter the Domain by now. Please, leave the negotiations to me. When they arrive, I will explain the matter in its entirety.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, we don't have to deal with the nitty-gritty? Great! Paimon hates negotiations...

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: My thanks to all of you. Without you, I never would have been able to regain my true self...

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I've prepared a gift for you. It may not be enough to repay your kindness, but I hope it will come in handy.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: A replica?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: You can call it Shiki Koshou.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Shiki Koshou is different to the other replicas. No matter where you go, it can maintain communication with me.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: It won't be able to use shikifuda or charm magic outside of the Mystic Onmyou Chamber, but it can still provide you with protection.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Bringing it with you on your travels is the same as having me by your side...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: (Shiki Taishou still sounds upset... is he worried we won't meet again?)

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Alright, now! No more sadness, you hear me? We ain't left just yet.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Besides, thanks to the Traveler, Kujou Sara, and Beidou, gettin' over to Inazuma just got a whole lot easier. I might just have to start payin' you a regular visit.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Miss Xinyan... Wouldn't that take up too much of your time?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Well, let me ask you a question. What do you think of rock 'n' roll?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Rock 'n' roll... To me, it's wonderful music.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Then that's good enough for me. I only ever perform for people that can appreciate it anyway.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Speakin' of which, prepare your ears y'all, it's about to get louder.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? You're gonna perform right now!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, Paimon never realized how uplifting this number was...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, Tartaglia can dance, right? Let's get him to... Huh? Where'd he go?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Tartaglia! Where do you think you're going? Trying to sneak off on us, huh!?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Sneak off? I'm just looking for a place to put my feet up and muse for a while is all.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Traveler, it's time I told you about my investigations.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Still sharp as always. I do sometimes wonder if you can read minds...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I had a lot of fun here. In fact, I really like Inazuma. As long as I don't dwell on minor problems... and the trouble they cause.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I originally came to this Domain because I thought that it might have something to do with The Balladeer. As it turns out, he's not here.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Scaramouche is in possession of a certain Gnosis, and we happen to have lost contact with him... I don't suppose it's a coincidence.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Of course, it didn't surprise me in the slightest that Scaramouche would do something like this. My agenda as a Harbinger is to seek out combat, and nearly every Fatui Harbinger has an agenda of their own too.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I'll let the Gnosis run for a while longer. I'm sure it's only a matter of time before you discover its whereabouts. When that time comes, Traveler, what will you choose to do? And where is your final destination?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: *sigh* I wish I could stay here a while longer. The more time you spend somewhere, the more joy it brings you when you return.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: You're like the stars in the night sky, comrade. You never cease to surprise me.

choices.text: Does it have to do with my past experiences?
If only we had some music over the top of that...

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Your music brings out a different feeling in me now that my state of mind has changed.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Miss Xinyan, thank you for helping me to understand the magnitude and depth of music. I will never forget our friendship.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Aw, shucks. The next time we meet, I'll have even more rock 'n' roll for you to feast your ears on!
